scenarioMetadata.scenarioDescription: All three stages present — healthy baseline, no gap.
scenarioMetadata.expectedExplanation: All 3 Audit Events present for all pipeline stages within normal timing.

workerLogs.message: Event written to index store successfully.
Event published to downstream consumers successfully.

scenarioMetadata.scenarioDescription: No audit events recorded at all. Ingest gates both Index and Publish — the event never entered the pipeline.
scenarioMetadata.expectedExplanation: No IngestAuditEvent recorded; the IngestionWorker logged a connection drop before the payload could be read.

auditEvents.name: IngestAuditEvent
auditEvents.exceptionMessage: Connection to upstream partner feed dropped before payload could be read; no event was parsed.

workerLogs.message: Connection to upstream partner feed dropped before payload could be read; no event was parsed.

scenarioMetadata.scenarioDescription: Ingest and Publish are present, but Index is missing. Index and Publish run as separate, independent parallel workers — Publish can complete even if Indexing fails.
scenarioMetadata.expectedExplanation: No IndexAuditEvent recorded; the IndexingWorker logged a connection timeout to the index store, while Ingest and Publish both completed successfully.

auditEvents.name: IndexAuditEvent
auditEvents.exceptionMessage: Failed to write index entry: connection timeout to index store.

workerLogs.message: Failed to write index entry: connection timeout to index store.

scenarioMetadata.scenarioDescription: Publish audit event never recorded — Ingest and Index present. The most common real-world gap: an event fully processed internally but never made it to downstream consumers.
scenarioMetadata.expectedExplanation: No PublishAuditEvent recorded; the PublishingWorker exceeded the connection retry limit to EventHub, so the event never reached downstream consumers.

auditEvents.name: PublishAuditEvent
auditEvents.exceptionMessage: Failed to publish event to EventHub: connection retry limit exceeded.

workerLogs.message: Failed to publish event to EventHub: connection retry limit exceeded.

scenarioMetadata.scenarioDescription: All three audit events are present but the Ingest-to-Publish gap is ~17.1 minutes, exceeding the 15-minute SLA threshold. The PublishingWorker experienced transient EventHub throttling and retried successfully, but the cumulative delay breached SLA. No data loss occurred.
scenarioMetadata.expectedExplanation: All 3 Audit Events present but the Ingest-to-Publish gap (~17.1 min) exceeds the 15-minute SLA threshold; the PublishingWorker logged repeated EventHub throttle errors before eventually succeeding.

workerLogs.message: EventHub publish throttled (attempt 1/5); backing off for 60 seconds.
EventHub publish throttled (attempt 2/5); backing off for 120 seconds.
EventHub publish throttled (attempt 3/5); backing off for 240 seconds.
EventHub publish throttled (attempt 4/5); backing off for 240 seconds.
Event published successfully after 4 retries (total delay: 17m 9s).

scenarioMetadata.scenarioDescription: No audit events recorded at all, and the only worker log is a generic restart warning with no eventId and no actionable context. Evidence is entirely absent — root cause is genuinely indeterminate.
scenarioMetadata.expectedExplanation: No audit events recorded and no worker log provides a specific failure reason or eventId correlation; the only signal is a generic IngestionWorker restart warning. Evidence is insufficient to determine root cause — manual review required.

workerLogs.message: Worker restarted after unexpected shutdown. No context available.
